environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime) deployed behind API Gateway (REST API, no request validation). Lambda execution role has SecretsManager:GetSecretValue, RDS full access, and S3 read access. The function is invoked via POST /render-notification endpoint. No WAF attached to the API Gateway stage. Lambda environment variables include standard AWS credential injection (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN) with role session duration of 1 hour. Secrets Manager secret 'prod/db/credentials' has rotation disabled.

config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validation model
config.network: public API endpoint, no VPC attachment
